title: Yandex Self-Driving Car. Moscow streets after a heavy snowfall
summary: Yandex shows its self-driving taxi navigating snowy Moscow streets after a heavy snowfall, dealing with traffic, pedestrians, parked cars and snowbanks on real roads.
why: Cited as evidence that Yandex already runs capable self-driving cars in harsh weather, though some commenters doubted the footage.

quote.text: This video of a car navigating a snowy Moscow street is especially impressive [0].
